threads.body: Could the new content_capturing_mode option be added to the LangChain and util-genai READMEs? Right now they only explain the environment variable, so users will not know that this programmatic option exists or that it takes precedence

replies.body: I wanted to have this PR as a protoype. This is not the final PR. I wanted to get an approval on the approach before proceeding with the changes.

threads.body: Could we add tests for EVENT_ONLY and SPAN_AND_EVENT that verify where the content is recorded? The current tests only check whether capture is enabled, so they would not catch content being written to the span instead of the event, or vice versa.

This introduces a user-visible `instrument()` configuration option, but the LangChain README still documents only the environment variable (`README.rst:126-139`). Please document the `ContentCapturingMode` example and precedence here as required by the [instrumentation README rule](https://github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-python-genai/blob/main/.github/instructions/instrumentation.instructions.md#readme).

This public `TelemetryHandler` option changes util-genai behavior, but the PR only adds a LangChain changelog fragment. Package release selection reads each package's own `.changelog` directory (`scripts/eachdist.py:877-895`), so the util 1.3b0 release notes would omit this feature. Add `util/opentelemetry-util-genai/.changelog/840.added`, as required for each affected package by `AGENTS.md:175-181`.

This issue also appears on line 94 of the same file.
